_comment: AGENT: always read this file via the task-index-manager skill before reading or writing any task state. System tracker for ai-worldbuilder (ADR 002). Never add tasks for individual worlds here

tasks.title: issues.json: snags-as-evidence issue tickets (lib + scripts/issues.py)
tasks.notes: Per-world registry/issues.json; snags only nested in issues (source you|agent, confidence, elements, pic). Fix log with per-snag check lines. States open->fix-landed->confirmed|wontfix; fix-landed only when a tagged element has a new landed build (changed blob hash) after the fix merged (cell journal). CLI: add (new issue or evidence on existing), match, fix, move, merge, review, list, verify. Regressions: closed issues are match candidates and reopen. Never blocks cells.

tasks.title: Retire I-nnn ISSUES.txt: stop issues blocking cells / steering next
tasks.notes: Remove registry_issues + add-issue, journal 'issue'/'close' notes counting against done, next_open_issue, site_kit close_for_build auto-close, verify check_issue_notes, handoff _open_issues. Update refine/redo/cell-orchestrator/rules pointers; retire human-confirm-fix (superseded by snag skill).

tasks.title: Skills: snag (intake+review) and sherlock (read-only investigator), seed from docs/snags
tasks.notes: snag: in-world intake with human-readable match prompt, review walk-through teleporting the player (mc_player.py move) per snag. sherlock: light Holmes tone, never builds/purges/changes code, proposes tasks with permission and a next-step sequence.
